# Alibaba API

> Reverse-engineered internal API. Unofficial — may change without notice.

## Authentication
Cookie-based (token) — Authentication method detected from captured traffic.

### Providing credentials
- Prefer passing auth as request headers or cookies at call time (do not hardcode secrets into the skill).
- If executing via an external proxy/executor, pass per-call credentials (cookies and/or headers) so they are not persisted.

## Dependencies
- Runtime capable of HTTPS requests.
- If using `scripts/api.ts`: TypeScript toolchain (or transpile to JS).

## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (4)
- `GET /@xconfig/micro_frontend/{micro_frontendToken}` — Authenticate and retrieve micro-frontend configuration.
- `GET /csrf/getToken.htm` — Get a CSRF token for authentication.
- `POST /csrf/getToken.htm` — Request a CSRF token.
- `POST /message/opTagAuthority.htm` — Request operation tag authority.

### Data Read (7)
- `GET /@mcms/combine` — Retrieve combined data from MCMS.
- `GET /ajax/availableSurveyQuery.json` — Check for available surveys.
- `GET /faas/micro-front` — Retrieve micro-frontend data.
- `GET /h5/{h5Id}/1.0/` — Retrieve data from an H5 page.
- `GET /lt-address/shipto/recommendShipTo` — Get recommended shipping addresses.
- `GET /openservice/preloadCdnDataService` — Preload CDN data.
- `GET /payment/ajaxQueryLocalizedLogo.json` — Get localized payment logo.

### Data Write (1)
- `POST /service/um.json` — Send user metrics data.

### Config (7)
- `GET /@xconfig/dataphant/{dataphantId}/{dataphantId}` — Retrieve Dataphant configuration.
- `GET /@xconfig/dataphant/im-messenger` — Retrieve IM messenger configuration.
- `GET /@xconfig/EcoNet/networkSpeedMap` — Get network speed map configuration.
- `GET /@xconfig/header/{headerId}` — Fetch header configuration by ID.
- `GET /@xconfig/icbu_marketing/popup/{popupId}` — Get popup configuration by ID.
- `GET /@xconfig/icbu_plugin_script/config/data` — Retrieve ICBU plugin script configuration data.
- `GET /@xconfig/im_fe_config/onetalk/weblitePWA` — Get OneTalk weblite PWA configuration.

```typescript
  const config = await client.get_xconfig_dataphant_dataphantId_dataphantId({ dataphantId: dataphantId });
  console.log("Dataphant Config:", config);
  return config;
}

getDataphantConfig("your_dataphant_id");
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Alibaba's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Alibaba data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.alibaba.com (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Alibaba frontend uses
